newsitem.title: UK: European VGO up on crude, low avails.
newsitem.headline: European VGO up on crude, low avails.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices ended the week higher on the back of limited supplies and crude's recent gains, traders said.
Traders assessed low sulphur VGO cargoes around the $130 mark, the level they traded at late on Thursday. The 40,000-tonne cargo was sold by a refiner.
High sulphur cargoes were said to be not far below, at $125 fob, also the level they last traded at on Thursday.
Traders said the trans-Atlantic arb that was shut with backwardation in NYMEX gasoline futures, opened as the futures reversed the trend.
"People are screaming for the stuff in the States," one trader said.
"Things have generally strenghthened with crude up and supplies are also limited," a second trader said.
